intent: Exact, reviewed JLCEDA DRC residuals for SPINC Golden Rev A after design clearances and native re-pour. The gate passes only when the live DRC violation multiset equals this list; any extra, missing or changed item fails.

residuals.reason: JLCEDA 'Other Spacing' measures the fiducial's component outline against the M3 mounting-hole pad (1.3 mil). Frozen KiCad: FID2 Fiducial_1mm_Mask2mm at (117.5,133.5) B.Cu, H1 MountingHole_3.2mm_M3_Pad_Via at (122,132); centre distance 4.743 mm, H1 pad radius 3.2 mm, FID2 copper radius 0.5 mm -> copper-to-copper gap 1.043 mm, above the design's 0.2 mm minimum and FID2's own 0.5 mm pad clearance. Placement is the designer's and is not changed.

Frozen schematic symbol R1 (10k, Device:R) is (in_bom no) (on_board no) (dnp yes): intentionally not on the board. JLCEDA's KiCad import keeps it in the schematic and reports the PCB/schematic netlist difference. The gate additionally requires the live component difference to be exactly schematic-only {R1} and PCB-only {REF**} (the board-only OSHW logo).
